verdict.rationale: CrewAI's own docs say it integrates with multiple LLM providers through their native SDKs, and that YAML agent configuration lets you easily switch between different models without touching agent code. A community report confirms the crew runs across models, with the caveat that many OSS Ollama models struggle with tool calling. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the swap mechanics and provider list, and independent hands-on confirmation that switching providers needs no agent changes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can swap the underlying LLM provider or model without rewriting my agent

citations.quote: CrewAI integrates with multiple LLM providers through providers native sdks, giving you the flexibility to choose the right model for your specific use case.
Works with most models good at tool calling
